# Framework mapping

Why each audit check matters, where the information comes from, and how it maps to four AI security frameworks. The same data is embedded in every audit report. For the real attacks behind the newer checks, see [THREATS.md](../THREATS.md).

| Framework | Version |
| --- | --- |
| [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/) | 2025 |
| [OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/resource/owasp-top-10-for-agentic-applications-for-2026/) | 2026 |
| [MITRE ATLAS](https://atlas.mitre.org/) | 2026.09 |
| [NIST AI Risk Management Framework](https://airc.nist.gov/airmf-resources/playbook/) | 1.0 |

Why each audit check matters, and how it maps to AI security frameworks. Mappings are AISecurityLabs.org's interpretation, verified against the framework versions shown with them; they are not endorsed by the framework owners.
